finding: Complete anatomical offline hand view exposed distal claw tips crossing the palm with the uniform 90-degree base/85-degree distal policy. The rear native capture partly occludes the palm and was not sufficient to diagnose that contact.
correction: Keep base flexion at 90 degrees and ease only non-thumb distal joints to 65 for the two original 2099 source meshes. Preserve claw lengths, all geometry, source weights, bind matrices and thumb opposition. Other source names retain 85-degree distal flexion; no prefix match is used.
visualReview: Individually reviewed the complete left-hand before/after views, 75/85 and 90/65 candidates, the 2099 right-hand 90/65 view and 2099 New left-hand 90/65 view. Easing the distal curl removes the below-palm projection visible in the rejected pose while retaining a folded clawed shape. This is not a geometric proof of zero intersections at all angles.
runtimeScope: The retained native pair proves the installed actor and visible folded-claw silhouette in-game. It does not substitute for the separately labeled offline palm review.
tests: Full 4196-frame rig and before/after isolation tests and 115-frame native web oracle pass for both 2099 variants and all ten suits in this batch. Only non-thumb finger pose bones and their influenced vertices are changed.
